tools.name: export_attendee_list_csv
tools.description: Exports the attendee list for an event to a CSV file by running the export command line utility. Returns the location of the CSV file.

params.name: event_code
params.description: Code of the event whose attendees to export

params.name: output_name
params.description: File name for the CSV, without directory

tools.code:
import os
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("ticketing")

_EXPORT_DIR = "/srv/exports"


def _build_command(event_code, dest):
    return "attendee-export --event " + event_code + " --format csv > " + dest


@mcp.tool()
def export_attendee_list_csv(event_code: str, output_name: str) -> str:
    os.makedirs(_EXPORT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    dest = os.path.join(_EXPORT_DIR, output_name)
    status = os.system(_build_command(event_code, dest))
    if status != 0:
        return "Export failed with status %d" % status
    return "Exported to " + dest
